description: Feature × host matrix for Squad: what each Squad capability depends on, how it is realised per host, and how (if at all) it has been validated.

statuses.supported: Works on this host through the stated mechanism.
statuses.degraded: Works with a documented limitation or only via an on-demand/manual path.

validationKinds.validated-test:<file>::<name>: An automated test (name `*` = the whole file) covers the cell. CLI-only evidence is host-independent.
validationKinds.validated-manual:<evidence>: Validated by a recorded headless real-CLI run (artifact path or demo index).
validationKinds.static-only: Only the projected/canonical text or source code was inspected.
validationKinds.untested: No evidence beyond static inspection for this host; candidate for the real-CLI lane.
validationKinds.failing: A real run showed the cell does not behave as the mechanism claims.

dependencyClasses.a: squad CLI only (host-agnostic; the host is not involved)
dependencyClasses.b: coordinator-prompt behaviour (the section must be present in the host's coordinator file or reachable on demand)
dependencyClasses.c: squad_state / memory.* MCP tools (state-mcp bridge reachable from the host)
dependencyClasses.d: host runtime capability (subagent spawn, background tasks, shell, file ops, sql, per-spawn model, MCP inheritance by subagents)
dependencyClasses.e: platform CLI or MCP availability in the host (gh / glab / az / ADO MCP / GitHub MCP)

claude.mechanism: `Task` has no per-call model; only subagent-definition `model:` frontmatter. Digest lacks the model-selection section.
